takeaways.text: Lines up **Wide (outside)** on **73%** of 233 plays (n=170); also Slot 27% (n=63).
Runs a route on **100%** of dropbacks — about the WR average (100%). Effectively always a receiver; blocking is negligible.
On routes, averages **11.7 yd** downfield by the throw (n=233, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Wide (outside) (73%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.
